# R5.22 — Owner-typed reference closure and materialization

Implements docs/tickets/192_R5.22__closure.md (seq 192 of 246).
Requirement ids: **REQ-F-005** (primary target — achieved
engineered D/E recorded; the full-target predicate stays owed to
its named later owners per the coverage register), **REQ-A-103,
REQ-E-208** (contributing only — never duplicate ownership).

## Summary

Lands `closure_walk`/`closure_report` — the owner-typed
recipient-closure interface inside `hh-bundle` (spec §6.2; Packet C
/ PADR-R5-3∗ C.1 items 3–4, C.4; admitted GATE-G9): every required
reference enumerated by its owning codec and resolved truthfully
against the recipient's own member bytes — a `closed`/`withheld`/
`failed` verdict a recipient can reach with an inaccessible
producer home, store, cache or credential.

## What changed

- `crates/hh-bundle/src/closure.rs` (new) — one public entry,
  `closure_walk(&Decoded, WalkOpts) → ClosureReport`:
  - **Owner-typed root enumeration** — manifest members,
    `section_member_refs`/`derived_from`, `contains:` manifest
    recursion (depth-bounded), `subject.lineage`, decoded
    `evidence-package/1` claim/coordinate roots
    (`native_refs`/`report_refs`, attempts/grade_attempts/exports/
    native_heads/watermarks/legacy_refs), trace
    tree/pages/`blob_index`/head/checkpoints/`audit_tree_head`/
    `lineage_prefixes`, event `causes`/`refs`/`ir_refs` +
    class-table `content_refs` (an unregistered class is
    `unknown_class`), `manifest_refs` off `lifecycle.run.created`.
    No hash regex, no second class table (C.10).
  - **Provenance + bounds** — each edge carries `{parent, role,
    field, media, size, owner, kind, target}`; visited dedup on the
    provenance tuple; `ClosureLimits{max_edges, max_depth,
    max_events}` and expansion-stack cycle detection fail
    `traversal_limit`/`cycle`, never pass partially.
  - **Truthful resolution** — `present` requires recipient bytes
    recomputing to the address + size agreement (`digest_mismatch`/
    `bad_size`/`missing_bytes`); `fetch` materializes through the
    landed `fetch::fetch` only under a caller `FetchPermit`
    (verified arrival, never executed; refusals verbatim);
    `redacted`/`gc` withhold; nested `contains:` statuses resolve
    against their declaring index; no producer home/store/cache/
    credential fallback.
  - **`closure-report/1` sidecar** — `{schema, bundle_id,
    profile_version, procedure, recipient_class, checked_at,
    required, resolved, withheld, unresolved, verdict, failures[],
    edges[], fetched[]}`; closed failure-code set under
    `closure::code`; never joins `max_supported_level`; `fetched[]`
    carries verbatim `bundle.member.fetched` rows for the caller's
    durable landing (`require_ledgered_arrival`).
- `crates/hh-bundle/src/lib.rs` — `pub mod closure` + re-exports
  (+5 lines).
- `tests/r5_22.rs` — 9-check AC battery (compile-red at base).
- ADR-0400 (landing record); coverage dated contributing note;
  BL-47 append + regenerated ADR index/revisit triggers.

## Design decisions (ADR-0400)

The report is the walk's own fold — one interface, not two
contracts (C.1 items 3–4); the declaring index speaks first (a
nested manifest's statuses withhold against its own index);
limit exhaustion is a failure, never a truncated `closed`;
unregistered classes are unknowable partitions and fail closure;
`fetched` bytes ride the landed fetch trust/expiry/locator rules
and are never executed.
